content:
🚀 Exciting News! 🚀

I'm thrilled to share that I've officially joined the Project Management Committee of the CDS Hooks initiative! Having worked with this transformative standard since 2017, I’m deeply passionate about its potential to enhance healthcare workflows and improve patient care.

As a member of the committee, I’m excited to help move the CDS Hooks standard forward, fostering collaboration and innovation in our community.

If you’re already using CDS Hooks, I encourage you to add your implementation to our growing list here: [CDS Hooks Availability](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability). Let's showcase the diverse applications of this standard!

And for those who haven’t yet jumped on board, I’m here to help! As a freelance consultant, I offer guidance and support for successful implementations tailored to your needs.

Let’s drive the future of healthcare together! 💡🌟

#CDSHooks #HealthTech #ProjectManagement #Consulting #HealthcareInnovation
